settings.title: Translate
settings.header.title: Translate
settings.header.subtitle: Tonality and terminology used when translating entries with the LLM.
settings.voice.title: Voice and tone
settings.voice.description: Free-form instructions injected into the translator's system prompt. Describe the desired voice, register, or product-specific phrasing.
settings.voice.label: Instructions
settings.voice.placeholder: e.g. Warm, inviting hospitality copy. Keep tone natural to the target language — do not translate literally.
settings.voice.hint: Plain text. Avoid contradicting the built-in rules (HTML preservation, JSON output, etc).
settings.preserve.title: Preserve exactly
settings.preserve.description: Terms kept verbatim across all target locales — brand names, place names, product names.
settings.glossary.title: Per-locale glossary
settings.glossary.description: When translating to the selected locale, the LLM is told to prefer the target term over a literal translation. Example: "Motorhome Pitches" → "Private Campsites" for English.
settings.glossary.empty: No mappings yet for this locale.
settings.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
settings.diagnostics.description: Translation memory cache and provider credit usage. Refresh to read the live state.
settings.diagnostics.cacheDisabled: Cache is disabled in plugin config (cache.enabled: false).
settings.toast.glossaryImported: Glossary loaded into the form. Click Save to persist.
